main_text.p: fuauius efficitur & vtilius, quin & fœminas nunc caftrare gula luxufque didicit. Ad extremum non prætereundum caueis conclufas, altilefque redditas, inque vrbium domibus vagantes & faginatas gulofis ganeonibus, fuauius quidem fapere, fed vitæ minus effe falutares, propterea quod vberiori excremento fcateant, probumq; fuccum non gignant, nam quæ in agris verfantur præftantiores exiltunt, vnde caponesfaluberrimi exiftimantur, qui circa tritici metas pinguefcunt, necfine exercitio, difcurruntenim vltro citroq;. Idem judicium fit de omni genere animantium, tum ferorum, tum cicurum, Nullumanimansquæ mortalibus cibaria præbent, in quib. faginailla atq; adipofa obelitas carcere etcarcere otioq; conciliata vitæ infidiofa deprehenditur & otio fagi-natumpeftifera. Sic columbæ quæ turres incolunt falubriores funt domefticis, & quæ in locis falubrehumilib. educantur, volatus enim falubritati præstat a-gratiam adiicit. Aues item montanæ campeftribus, &quein locis paluftrib. degunt, ficut & apri montani campeftribus præferuntur. limentis.Atq; hæc de auium differentia in genere, fequitur nunc de fingulis feorfim. Immenfam autem ac Numerofam volucrum multitudinem effe, teftatur cœna illa Vitellio à Vnā cœ-nāfratre data, in qua feptem avium millia ap-septemauiummillia ap-pofita traduntur, tantus fuit iftius feculi luxus tantaque vorago. pofita.Y 2 Aqua-

page.notes: The right-margin notes are running marginal phrases and are set in small type; their exact division into lines is uncertain, and the note breaks above follow the printed line ends as closely as the scan allows. The word "Proroganda" in the running head is partly faint; read as PROROGANDA with the fourth letter uncertain. The marginal word "praestat" and "limentis" may be split differently in print. The page is a continuation from page 338, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The signature "Y 2" and catchword "Aqua-" are printed at the foot. No reference marks appear in the text; margin notes are placed beside the lines where they sit.
